title: Databricks Product Announcements in 5 Minutes | Data + AI Summit 2026

segments.text: All right, super excited! We don't need more intelligence for the AI, we need more
context. How do we enable all of you to lead this revolution? Genie One is
a data smart AI co -worker. It has full co -work capabilities. You can even
create autonomous agents just by talking to Genie. Think about any function that has to
answer a bunch of questions. HR, IT, finance. You can create documents, and
again, compute them live. Not just summarize and recite existing things that you have, but
net new analysis. You can connect them into all of your systems. Schedule it to
work in the background. Genie Ontology provides the
metadata layer over all of your agentic assets so that your agents can effectively and
efficiently retrieve and select context. It's constructing a graph of the most
important knowledge that you have inside of your organization. It's not just everything that you
have in the lake house and everything you have in Databricks. It also connects to
your Google Drive, SharePoint, your email, Google Calendar. It basically allows Genie and any agents
attached to the ontology to do a much better job of accurately answering questions with
data. Genie App Builder is vibe coding that understands
your business. It's embedded. It's 100 % Databricks managed. So it provides the strongest security
and governance guarantees. And finally, it's production quality by default.
We call it Genie Zero Ops. It looks at all your data pipelines. And it
sees that, okay, this pipeline is down at 2 a .m. It will then go
investigate. It will actually experiment with writing the code in a separate environment. And then
once it's ready, it will prepare it for you and it will send you a
notification. Lake House RT is a new
warehouse. It will support millisecond performance and massive concurrency. But the most important thing is
directly on the lake, governed by Unity Catalog on the same delta or iceberg data.
This is Lake Days. First, fully managed cross -cloud disaster recovery. It's
serverless Postgres that runs on the lake and it is mission critical. You can set
up your system to run cross -clouds. And in the case of outage, you can
instantly failover from one cloud to another. We're giving this
storage technology a name called LTAP. stands for Lake Transactional and Lake of Crossing. LTAP
can truly unify your data infrastructure. You start with the OLTP database for applications, but
you don't have to copy your data. There's no pipelines to maintain. And most importantly,
there's actually no compromise in performance at all. I'll be querying it with a new
type of warehouse, a real -time warehouse. And so now I click run and
it's done. It ran in milliseconds.
Lakeflow Designer, the no -code data prep tool powered by Genie is now available.
And I'm super excited to share that Lakeflow Connect now has more than a hundred
connectors. So what is Unity AI Gateway? It's a single pane
of glass. And there, you can actually have your one entry point for all of
your agents, for all of your AI. This is part of Unity Catalog, which we
open source. We need a new layer above the harness level
to manage and build with agents. The layer should be open so anyone can plug
in their own harness, their own workflows, their own tools. So that's Omnigent. Now you've
got an open source app you can use to build any agent with a great
interface. Agent Bricks is our agent developer platform. Agent Bricks
provides native model access and integration with all of the Frontier models. So you get
Opus, you get GPT, you get Gemini, you get Quen, and even recently you get
Kimmy. And today we're excited to announce in partnership with SpaceX that you now get
access to the Grok model family as well. We call this Customer Lake.
You need a new generation of CDPs to make Infinity campaigns work. And we call
this new generation the Agentix CDP. It's built for the business users, so it has
a business -first UI, and it is autonomous. It can empower one -to -one personalization
with agents to provide the perfect customer experience a billion times a day.
LakeWatch, which is our new Security Lakehouse product, you can leverage all of your data,
whether it's structured, unstructured, semi -structured data. Anything you need can come into your Security
Lakehouse. And then we can apply agents at every step of the process. This is
a massive acceleration for your SOC team. Thank you so much.
